On xi=0 facet, area=(1−Q2+ai²)/2 and h_{−K}(−ei)=1−ai; all facets with nonnegative normal have h_{−K}=0 since origin∈K. The surface-area mixed-volume formula gives V(K,K,−K)=[3−s−(2−s)Q2−Q3]/6 and symmetry yields R=20−6[s+(2−s)(Q2−Q3)/(1−Q3)]. Pairwise depth balancing at fixed v=x+y,z and product p=xy gives derivative of H=(Q2−Q3)/(1−Q3) equal −B(v,z)/(positive denominator squared), B=2−3v+v³+3vz²−2z³. Its min in z∈[0,1−v] is at endpoints; endpoint values (1−v)²(v+2)>0, 6v(1−v)²>0, so strict Schur concavity follows. Unique extremizers are (s,0,0) permutations and equal s/3 triple. Independent ConvexHull from all constraint-intersection vertices gives volume ratio matching rational formula for four distinct triples to <4×10⁻¹⁵, but finite samples do not prove majorization.
